BATTLE LOG

    👤 SHADOW ARMY — YOUR TEAM

    Your battle team holds 4 shadows — only they fight beside you. Tap a team slot to bench a shadow; use the + TEAM button on any shadow below to field it. The rest wait in reserve.

    ◆ THE 6 ELEMENTS & 4 ROLES

    Advantage cycle: 🔥 Fire → 🌪️ Wind → ⛰️ Earth → 💧 Water → 🔥 Fire, and ✨ Light ⇄ 🌑 Dark beat each other. Advantage = +30% damage, disadvantage = −20%. Build runes around each shadow's role: Attack wants Fatal + Rage, Defense wants Energy + Guard, Healers want Energy + Swift, Support wants Swift + Fatal.

    🎨 HUNTER CUSTOMIZATION

    🏅 TITLES — EARNED BY CLEARING GATES

    Every gate boss you bring down earns a new title. Equip one title at a time — each carries its own bonus to damage, speed, gold, XP, or defense.

    ◆ YOUR RUNES — 6 SLOTS

    Monsters drop runes — bosses always drop one. Tap a rune to inscribe it, tap an inscribed slot to remove it. Fatal +damage · Energy +HP · Guard damage cut · Rage +crit · Swift +shadow damage. Your shadows carry 6 rune slots of their own — inscribe theirs in Shadow Growth below.

    👤 SHADOW GROWTH — LEVELS & RUNES

    Shadows gain XP every time they attack in battle — plus a bonus for a killing blow. Each shadow has 6 rune slots and 4 skills shaped by its element and role: Attack shadows burst, Defense shadows shield you, Healers restore your HP, Support shadows buff the team. Evolve twice — at Lv 8 and Lv 16 — and each evolution doubles that shadow's power (×2, then ×4). On a shadow, Fatal · Energy · Guard · Swift add damage, Rage adds crit — so match runes to the role's strengths listed on its card.

    ⚔️ WEAPON TYPES & SKINS

    Your weapon level and upgrades carry across every type — swap freely to match your build. Skins restyle whichever weapon you hold, in the shop, in your party, and in battle.

    💾 Auto-save on — your level, gold, army, runes and gate progress are kept on this device between visits.

    Cross each gate along its expedition trail, hunter. In battle your shadow army fights beside you on its own turn bars — when a shadow's bar fills, its attacks appear and you pick the move; match their elements against the enemy for bonus damage. Turn on AUTO and your army picks its own attacks — crank the SPEED to farm gates like a true Monarch. Beat the boss and a portal opens: walk into it to descend. Bosses can be extracted as shadows: ARISE.

    🗺️ WORLD MAP

    Ten gates across the Monarch's realm, each steeped in its own element — its monsters lean into that element, and the runes it drops match the theme. Clear a gate's 10 stages on EASY to unlock the next gate and that gate's HARD mode; clear HARD to open HELL. Any cleared stage can be re-run to farm XP, gold and runes.
